name: Che Guevara
role: Argentine-Cuban revolutionary and Cuban minister of industries (1961–1965)
summary: Guevara advocated socialist revolution, public ownership and central planning, combined with moral incentives and the formation of a new socialist consciousness. He supported guerrilla struggle, anti-colonial liberation and international economic arrangements favouring dependent countries.
